description.zh:
校验AuthKey，用于生成回调信息的MD5签名。
> 回调时会在请求头中加两个鉴权字段，"SIG-TIME"表示当前时间戳，"ASR-SIG"表示md5鉴权字段，"ASR-SIG"字段的生成规则为md5(`${SIG-TIME}/${callbackurl}/${authKey}`)
description.en:
The authentication key used to generate the MD5 signature for callback information.
> Two authentication fields are added to the request header during callback: "SIG-TIME" indicates the current timestamp, and "ASR-SIG" indicates the MD5 authentication field. The "ASR-SIG" field is generated by the rule md5(`${SIG-TIME}/${callbackurl}/${authKey}`).

description.zh: 自动断流延时，单位秒，取值：1~10秒。
description.en: The automatic stream disconnection delay, in seconds. Valid values: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 断流最大延迟，超过则自动关闭任务。默认值：false。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically close the task when the stream disconnection exceeds the maximum delay. Default value: false.

description.zh:
房间号。
> 参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，否则不生效。
description.en:
The channel ID.
> This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

description.zh:
原音频语言，取值：
- 日语：ja。
- 粤语：yue。
- 中英文自由说：fspk。
- 英文：en。
- 中文：cn。
description.en:
The language of the source audio. Valid values:
- ja: Japanese.
- yue: Cantonese.
- fspk: Chinese-English free speech.
- en: English.
- cn: Chinese.

description.zh: 流模式，live或者rtc。live为正常直播流如rtmp。
description.en: The stream mode. Valid values: live and rtc. The value live indicates a standard live stream such as RTMP.

description.zh:
回调上报间隔，单位毫秒，取值范围：-1~500毫秒。
- -1：不接受中间结果，只接受整句回调。
- 0或不设置：实时上报回调结果。
- <=500毫秒：周期性间隔上报回调结果。
description.en:
The callback reporting interval, in milliseconds. Valid values: -1 to 500.
- -1: Does not accept intermediate results. Only full-sentence callbacks are accepted.
- 0 or not set: Reports callback results in real time.
- <=500 milliseconds: Reports callback results at periodic intervals.

description.zh:
推流用户ID。
> 参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，且只能填写一个，否则不生效。
description.en:
The stream ingest user ID.
> This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Only one value can be specified. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

description.zh:
ARTC应用ID。
> 当参数Mode取值为rtc时，此参数必填，否则不生效。
description.en:
The ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication application ID.
> This parameter is required when Mode is set to rtc. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

description.zh:
直播流地址。
> 参数Mode取值为live时，此参数必填，否则不生效。
description.en:
The streaming URL.
> This parameter is required when Mode is set to live. Otherwise, this parameter does not take effect.

description.zh:
目标翻译语种，取值：
- 中文：cn。
- 英文：en。
- 日文：ja。
description.en:
The target translation language. Valid values:
- cn: Chinese.
- en: English.
- ja: Japanese.

title.zh: 创建实时语音转文字或翻译

descriptions.zh:
本接口目前属于维护状态，建议通过智能工作流实现该能力，具体参考[智能工作流配置](~~2985843~~)。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为20次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is currently in maintenance mode. Use intelligent workflows to implement this capability. For more information, see [Intelligent workflow configuration](~~2985843~~).
## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 20 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-rtc-asr-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-mode live --sdk-app-id appId --channel-id channelId --rtc-user-id user1 --stream-url rtmp://xxx --biz-language cn --callback-url http://xxx.com --auth-key abcd --translate-enabled true --target-languages en --auto-terminate-enabled true --auto-terminate-delay 5 --report-interval 5 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateRtcAsrTask --region cn-hangzhou --TargetLanguages en --AutoTerminateEnabled true --Mode live --RtcUserId user1 --ChannelID channelId --StreamURL 'rtmp://xxx' --SDKAppID appId --CallbackURL 'http://xxx.com' --Language cn --TranslateEnabled true --ReportInterval 5 --AuthKey abcd --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AutoTerminateDelay 5
